title: Workflow Compression Opportunities

additionalCompression.opportunity: Parallelize Domain E Section E certification across Packs C and D
additionalCompression.detail: Pack C Section E (56 archived + 19 unprocessed) and Pack D Section E (56 archived + 19 unprocessed) are in different files. Two sessions can run in parallel: Session A certifies Pack C Section E items, Session B certifies Pack D Section E items. No write conflict.
additionalCompression.risk: MEDIUM — requires coordination to ensure both sessions use same certification methodology

additionalCompression.opportunity: Replace rather than repair archived clone items
additionalCompression.detail: 129 archived DL-012 clones in Domain E Sections require re-rotation + re-audit + EC authoring per item. Writing new unique items following Pack B quality template is faster than individually repairing each clone.
additionalCompression.risk: MEDIUM — content quality of replacement items must match or exceed replaced items

additionalCompression.detail: DL-013 boilerplate (851 fields), DL-031 difficulty recalibration (500 items), DL-032 case calibration, Pack E EC uplift, cross-pack EC normalization — all are quality polish, not learner-safety or certification-blocking. Can be deferred to a dedicated post-cert modernization phase without affecting certification timeline.
additionalCompression.risk: LOW — learners see current quality levels until modernization completes

additionalCompression.detail: Instead of per-session governance attestation, batch by certification wave. Run governance guard once per wave, write one REVISION_HISTORY entry per wave listing all certified QIDs.
additionalCompression.risk: LOW — traceability preserved at wave level

automationOpportunities: Pre-certification automated QA gate: DL-008 scan + parse check + answer-key balance + certified count
Batch distractor EW template generation for common trap patterns (double-count, sign error, term confusion)
Clone rotation pattern detection — automatically flag items with identical distractor text across rotation groups
EC length audit — flag items below 100-char EC for expansion
